newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Repsol denies Bridas buyout report.
newsitem.headline: Repsol denies Bridas buyout report.

text.p: Spain's Repsol has denied Argentine press reports that it is close to a $1 billion deal to buy local oil and gas firm Bridas Energy Corp, Argentine state news agency Telam reported Tuesday.

The news agency quoted Repsol spokesman Jose Maria Garcia Perote saying from the company's Madrid headquarters that it had not signed a buy option or letter of intent to buy the private Argentine energy firm.

"Repsol has not taken any decision on the matter. I can deny categorically that we have signed a letter of intent to buy Bridas in New York as some Argentine newspapers say," Garcia Perote was quoted as saying.

"Less still can we talk of a billion dollar investment when there is no decision to buy," he said, adding that the Spanish firm has a "generic interest" in Bridas, but its acquisition was not essential to Repsol's Argentine plans.
Argentine newspapers Clarin and La Nacion had reported that talks in New York would yield an imminent announcement.
La Nacion also said Mobil Corp linked up with Repsol for the deal. Mobil later confirmed it was one of the bidders for Bridas, but declined to comment on whether a deal was close.
